layout: Main hub for approved buddies after login. Top nav with greeting. Scrollable content sections. Bottom tab bar (Home active). Desktop: 3-column layout. Mobile: single column. Mirrors Seeker Dashboard structure but buddy-focused.
elements: TOP NAV: Navy (#0B1B3B) bar. Left: greeting 'Halo, [Nama]!' + small avatar (from profile photo). Right: notification bell with badge count (new bookings, messages).
SUMMARY STATS: 4 cards in a row (2x2 grid on mobile). Each: white bg, 16px radius, icon + number + label
Card 1: Calendar icon — '8' — 'Jadwal Aktif' (upcoming sessions this week)
Card 2: Wallet icon — 'Rp 2.400.000' — 'Saldo Tersedia' (withdrawable)
Card 3: Star icon — '4.9' — 'Rating' (current average)
Card 4: Users icon — '12' — 'Total Seeker' (unique clients)
EARNINGS SECTION: 'Pendapatan Bulan Ini' header
Bar chart / line chart simple: weekly earnings for current month (4 bars/points)
Below chart: 3 small stat pills — 'Minggu Ini: Rp 600K' | 'Bulan Lalu: Rp 2.1M' | 'Total: Rp 15.3M'
'Tarik Dana' button (outline, blue #003F8C) — navigates to withdrawal flow
UPCOMING SESSIONS: Horizontal scrollable row. 3 mini cards (like seeker dashboard).
Each card: Seeker photo (small), seeker name, date, time, duration, location, status badge ('Terkonfirmasi' / 'Menunggu')
Tap card → navigate to session detail (manage attendance, reschedule)
SCHEDULE MANAGEMENT: 'Jadwal Mingguan' section
Compact weekly view (Mon-Sun) with time blocks shown as colored bars on each day
'Edit Jadwal' button (ghost) → navigates to Schedule Setup screen (screen 12)
RECENT ACTIVITY: Vertical list, 5 items max. Each: icon + description + time + amount (if earning)
Examples: 'Booking baru dari Rangga — Rp 150K — 2 jam lalu', 'Payout Rp 500K berhasil — Kemarin', 'Review 5★ dari Bu Dewi — 3 hari lalu'
QUICK ACTIONS: 3 large action cards in a row (stack on mobile)
Card 1: Calendar + 'Atur Jadwal' → Schedule Setup
Card 2: Wallet + 'Tarik Dana' → Withdrawal flow
Card 3: Chart + 'Lihat Statistik' → Detailed analytics page
TIER & PROGRESS: Small card showing current tier badge + progress to next tier
Example: Gold badge + 'Butuh 3 review 5★ lagi untuk tier Pro'
BOTTOM TAB BAR: Floating pill. Items: Home (active orange), Jadwal, Booking, Wallet, Profil
notes: Mirrors Seeker Dashboard layout for consistency. Stats cards show buddy metrics (not seeker). Earnings chart is key motivator. Quick actions drive core behaviors. Tier progress gamifies growth.
